source_clause: C11.) Climate off has on/off state that is indicated on HC, TS (climate screen) and in status bar. Climate off affects every climate function with the exception of FRONT /MAX DEFROST (depending on equipment) and REAR DEFROST (and seat/wheel controls). When the system is turned off, show the CLIMATE OFF screen with the OFF button turned into an ON button and grey out remaining buttons except for Front/max defrost and rear defrost. Category button shows fan greyed out and mode oscar replaced with "OFF" which will remain until the user turns it back on. Temperatures and units (°F/C) in status bar are substituted by dashes in all modes when climate is off. If a user presses a temp/fan control to turn climate back on, the system reinstates to the last level of that feature and if Front/Max Defrost is selected, the climate system turns back on (does not happen with rear defrost, heated/vented seats or heated wheel). If the user continues to hold/turn the control, the system will respond in-kind.
reasoning: 驗證目標：2.10（C11）定出 climate off 之畫面、按鈕灰化之例外、category button 與 status bar 之呈現，以及以 temp/fan 控制回復之行為，六個 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：`-144` 另補第五軸（MAX DEF 有無，出處 3.2）與第十軸（REAR DEFROST 有無，出處 3.4）—— 該條之 ER 以該二鍵**不灰化**為觀察對象，其不存在即使該觀察無對象；依 **R-C34** 第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補，EMEA 排除補並逐條答，第十二軸不補。為什麼這樣切：`-147`（回復至上次等級）與 `-148`（持續按住持續變化）為同一操作之兩個階段，其失效可獨立發生（回復了但停在最低／回復正確但不續動）。刻意略過：C11 之「Climate off affects every climate function with the exception of…」為總述句，037 未另給 leaf，故不另立 TC；其可觀察內容已由 `-144` 之灰化例外涵蓋（§4.5：同一可觀察量不得由兩個 leaf 共用）。

distinguishing_axis.axis: which side of the climate-off exception the section owns (2.10 vs 3.3)
distinguishing_axis.delta: `2.10`（C11）自**通則**一側陳述：climate off 時其餘按鈕灰化，而 Front/Max defrost 與 rear defrost 為例外；`3.3`（C21）自**例外**一側陳述：MAX DEF 與 REAR DEF 於 climate off 期間可用。`-144` 之 verification target 為「其餘按鈕變灰」，`-030` 之 target 為「該二者仍可用」—— 四項嚴格等價中 verification target 相異，故不構成 `duplicate_of`；惟兩者共用同一條文事實，記此以免重複驗證

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: CLIMATE OFF 畫面、category button、status bar 與硬控回復行為
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量皆在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3 使其移除）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車無 HVAC 畫面／popup，出處 2.14）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: 補排除；**逐條答見各 TC 之 `emea_ics_review`**（R-C36-1）—— 本節之 ch16 對造與其分界見 `ch16_mirror_map.tsv`

tcs.tc_title: Climate off shows the CLIMATE OFF screen
tcs.test_item: When the system is turned off the system shall show the CLIMATE OFF screen with the OFF button turned into an ON button
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The climate screen is open and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the climate system off using the climate power button on the climate screen
2. Read the power button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CLIMATE OFF screen is displayed
2. The power button reads ON
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ICE9「When the system is turned off, show the CLIMATE OFF screen with the OFF button turned into an ON button」逐字相同

tcs.tc_title: Only the defrost buttons stay available while climate is off
tcs.test_item: The system shall grey out the remaining buttons except for Front/max defrost and rear defrost
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The climate screen is open and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with MAX DEF (3.2) and with rear defrost, which is absent on some soft top vehicles (3.4)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn the climate system off using the climate power button on the climate screen
2. Read the "MAX DEF" and "REAR DEFROST" buttons
3. Read the remaining climate buttons
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CLIMATE OFF screen is displayed
2. "MAX DEF" and "REAR DEFROST" are not greyed out
3. The remaining climate buttons are greyed out
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ICE9「grey out remaining buttons except for Front/Max defrost and rear defrost」逐字相同

tcs.tc_title: A temp or fan control turns climate back on at its last level
tcs.test_item: If a user presses a temp/fan control to turn climate back on, the system shall reinstate the last level of that feature

2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
